0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-5, 14th in the West) are on a four-game losing streak and sit 3.5 games back in the Northwest, while the New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the West) have won two straight and are 4 games back in the Southwest. Utah is 1-4 at home and 0-1 on the road, and New Orleans is 2-2 at home and 0-2 on the road. Both teams are missing players: Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are out for Utah, and Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out for New Orleans. The Jazz lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on October 23, and they lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season.
